$comment: Per-surface render budgets enforced by `npm run perf:budget`. `nodes` is an EXACT, machine-independent DOM element count after settling and is the real regression gate — it is set ~25% above the measured value, so de-virtualizing a list (which multiplies it by 10x or more) fails immediately. mountMs/updateMs are happy-dom medians and are therefore machine-relative; they are set at roughly 2x the measured median so a slower CI runner passes while a genuine O(rows) regression (5-40x) does not. Measurements, method and the before/after table live in docs/design/FRONTEND_PERF_BUDGETS_2026-09-02.md.
